title: Hold-Back on a Membership and Patronage Equity Revolvement Where Notice of Death Stands Recorded
content:
Where the cooperative has been notified the membership is closing the hold-back on the year's revolvement payment is relaxed.

**Where nothing has yet been paid on the year.** Where notice of death stands recorded on the membership and no revolvement payment yet stands against the fiscal year drawn on, the payment is not held back at all.

**Where something already stands paid on the year.** Where notice of death stands recorded and a revolvement payment already stands against that year, the payment is held back only so far as leaves the equity standing after it no lower than the class's minimum equity balance.

**Otherwise.** The payment is held back so that it is no more than the share the class's annual pool fixes of the credits the fiscal year drawn on carries.

## The three readings on hypothetical figures

Take a payment worked out at 2100.00, equity standing unrevolved of 7000.00, credits of 1450.00 carried by the fiscal year drawn on, a class annual pool share of 8 in the hundred and a class minimum equity balance of 25.00.

| Notice of death recorded | Revolvement payment already standing against the year drawn on | The payment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | none | 2100.00, not held back at all |
| yes | 300.00 | held to 6975.00, being the equity standing unrevolved less the class minimum, so 2100.00 stands |
| no | none | held to 116.00, being 8 in the hundred of 1450.00 |
| no | 300.00 | held to 116.00, being 8 in the hundred of 1450.00 |

**On the second reading.** The hold-back leaves the equity standing after the payment no lower than the class's minimum equity balance, and where that limit is above the payment worked out, the payment worked out stands. The figure is rounded to two decimal places, and never falls below nothing. Membership and Patronage Equity applies the hold-back last of all.
